_comment: REFERENCE CATALOG ONLY. This file is never read by `wp setup`. It documents commonly used WordPress plugins so you can pick slugs for plugins.install / plugins.remove in config/setup.json. Installing plugins requires listing them in config/setup.json.

plugins.name: classic-editor
plugins.description: Restores the previous WordPress block editor (TinyMCE)

plugins.name: advanced-custom-fields
plugins.description: Custom fields and content modeling (free version)

plugins.name: acf-pro
plugins.description: Advanced Custom Fields PRO - requires your own license key in secrets/env.json

plugins.name: simple-history
plugins.description: Audit log of changes made in WordPress

plugins.name: wps-hide-login
plugins.description: Change or hide the default /wp-login.php URL

plugins.name: disable-comments
plugins.description: Disable comments site-wide or per post type

plugins.name: duplicate-post
plugins.description: Clone posts and pages for editing

plugins.name: query-monitor
plugins.description: Developer debugging panel for hooks, queries and scripts
